name: @autom8x/invoice-processing
description: Invoice Processing (v2): reads a bill, receipt, credit note or statement from a PDF or photo, then saves its details for the team, or records it in QuickBooks Online when the flow's vendor is QuickBooks. One AI read, a second only when the first shows a problem; accounts read from QuickBooks, never typed; QuickBooks failing mid-run saves the details instead. After the checks an approval calls for, it creates the one record planned, and emails a summary when an address is set.
